target.title: fix(session): stop repeated restart recovery after retry budget
target.body:
Related: #95750

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where operators can get stuck in a gateway restart death-loop for the same wedged main session. After the gateway restarts, the persisted aborted session can keep entering automatic restart recovery instead of being stopped once repeated automatic recovery has already shown that the session is wedged.

The user-visible failure mode is repeated automatic main-session resume across gateway boots, which keeps the gateway focused on the same wedged session instead of leaving the row in a terminal state for operator inspection.

## Why This Change Was Made

This keeps the durable stop-condition direction from the existing PR, but changes the policy to the maintainer-requested recovery-fuse model rather than a generic cross-boot retry counter:

- Main-session restart recovery now has its own optional `mainRestartRecovery` state, aligned with the existing subagent tombstone shape: `automaticAttempts`, `lastAttemptAt`, `lastRunId`, `wedgedAt`, and `wedgedReason`.
- Only accepted automatic resume dispatches charge the durable fuse. Transcript preflight failures, transcript read failures, and dispatch-before-acceptance failures do not consume the fuse.
- Two rapid accepted automatic recovery attempts within two minutes are allowed; the next rapid re-entry tombstones the row before dispatch, clears `abortedLastRun`, and transitions the session to `failed` with terminal timing fields.
- `restartRecoveryRuns` stays a lifecycle-generation ignore list. For old released rows that only have repeated `restartRecoveryRuns` markers, recovery uses those markers only as a conservative compatibility floor, not as the canonical counter.
- The existing in-process `MAX_RECOVERY_RETRIES` remains a transient startup retry/backoff guard and is no longer the durable cross-boot policy.

Boundaries and non-goals:

- The new persisted state is optional and scoped to automatic main-session restart recovery; existing rows do not need migration.
- This does not change credentials, auth, provider discovery, network behavior, public config defaults, wire protocol, Telegram/systemd runtime behavior, or lifecycle event suppression semantics.
- This does not add a new full Telegram/systemd/live-provider loop proof in this local environment. The PR already carries the prior Mantis Telegram Desktop gateway-run proof from the PR discussion, and this update adds issue-specific file-backed runtime proof through the production restart-recovery entrypoint.
- Another open candidate was visible for the same issue; this update repairs the existing contributor PR and leaves final landing-path choice to maintainers.

## User Impact

Operators get a durable automatic recovery stop condition across gateway restarts. A wedged main session can make two rapid accepted automatic recovery attempts, but the next rapid restart tombstones the row instead of repeatedly dispatching another resume. Deterministic transcript failures fail before charging that liveness fuse, so a bad transcript tail is not retried as if it were a transient gateway dispatch problem.

After inspection, `openclaw doctor --fix` can clear stale aborted recovery flags without deleting the tombstone metadata.

## Evidence

Issue-specific runtime proof through the production main-session restart-recovery entrypoint:

```text
Validation `post-commit-runtime-restart-recovery-tombstone-proof` (pass, exit_code=0)
[main-session-restart-recovery] tombstoned main-session restart recovery: agent:main:main (main-session restart recovery blocked after 2 rapid accepted resume attempts; run "openclaw doctor --fix" to clear stale restart-recovery flags after inspection)
proof exhausted-fuse: skipped=1, no resume dispatch path, durable tombstone persisted, terminal lifecycle closed
[main-session-restart-recovery] tombstoned main-session restart recovery: agent:main:main (main-session restart recovery blocked after 3 rapid accepted resume attempts; run "openclaw doctor --fix" to clear stale restart-recovery flags after inspection)
proof legacy-markers: old released row maps restartRecoveryRuns to a conservative tombstone gate before resume dispatch
[main-session-restart-recovery] marked interrupted main session failed: agent:main:main (transcript tail is not resumable)
[main-session-restart-recovery] main-session restart recovery complete: recovered=0 failed=1 skipped=0
proof preflight: non-resumable transcript fails before resume dispatch and does not charge durable fuse
runtime proof: restart-recovery durable fuse/tombstone and preflight boundaries verified on current local head
```

Focused regression coverage for the main-session restart-recovery policy and shared recovery helper:

```text
Validation `targeted-main-restart-recovery-tests` (pass, exit_code=0)
Test Files 1 passed (1)
Tests 43 passed (43)

Validation `subagent-orphan-recovery-tests` (pass, exit_code=0)
Test Files 1 passed (1)
Tests 19 passed (19)
[test] passed 1 Vitest shard in 11.73s

Validation `doctor-state-integrity-main-tombstone-test-post-commit` (pass, exit_code=0)
Test Files 1 passed (1)
Tests 34 passed (34)
[test] passed 1 Vitest shard in 284.93s
```

Additional targeted regression coverage retained from this PR update:

```text
Validation `post-recreate-targeted-session-recovery-tests` (pass, exit_code=0)
Test Files 6 passed / Tests 470 passed
Test Files 2 passed / Tests 58 passed
Test Files 2 passed / Tests 91 passed
[test] passed 3 Vitest shards

Validation `post-clawsweeper-admission-agents-recovery-tests-rerun` (pass, exit_code=0)
Test Files 3 passed / Tests 167 passed
```

Static checks on the current code diff:

```text
Validation `tsgo-core` (pass, exit_code=0)
Validation `tsgo-core-test` (pass, exit_code=0)
Validation `lint-core` (pass, exit_code=0)
Validation `diff-check` (pass, exit_code=0)
Validation `removed-flat-recovery-field-scan` (pass, exit_code=0)
```

Review finding disposition:

- Durable stop condition: main-session restart recovery now uses a dedicated `mainRestartRecovery` fuse/tombstone state instead of flat retry/quarantine fields.
- Retry semantics: the durable policy is two rapid accepted automatic recovery attempts within two minutes, not three cross-boot retries. In-process retry/backoff remains separate.
- Charging boundary: only accepted gateway resume dispatch records an automatic attempt. Transcript preflight/read failures and dispatch rejection before acceptance do not charge the durable fuse.
- Tombstone lifecycle: exhausted rows transition to `failed`, clear `abortedLastRun`, stamp `endedAt` and `runtimeMs`, and persist `wedgedAt` / `wedgedReason`.
- Legacy row compatibility: old rows with repeated `restartRecoveryRuns` and no `mainRestartRecovery` can still tombstone conservatively before dispatch, while `restartRecoveryRuns` remains a lifecycle event suppression list.
- Normal progress cleanup: ordinary user progress clears stale automatic recovery state, while trusted `main_session_restart_recovery` resume turns preserve it.
